mastery_target: Expose actual workload, resource, provider, configuration, federation, and evidence state through consistent CLI/API views; drill-down explains blocked work and actions obey the same grants and preconditions as automation.
summary: The unified operator control surface is not delivered. Current implementation provides partial operator views (tui_top renders providers and GPU), but lacks the unified API/CLI surface required by the mastery target.

components: tui_top module renders providers (name, health, latency) with GPU utilization, temperature, and VRAM
susi fix applies safe doctor findings to initialize workspace structure

missing.unified_api_surface: No single GET /operator/state or /susi/status endpoint that exposes all six state dimensions (workload, resource, provider, configuration, federation, evidence)
missing.workload_state: DAG mission state, task queue depth, dependency tracking, and blocked task reasons not exposed via API/CLI
missing.resource_state: CPU utilization, memory usage, and load metrics not integrated into operator surface (GPU only partially via tui_top)
missing.configuration_state: Effective settings, layer origins (environment vs defaults), and configuration overrides not unified or exposed
missing.federation_state: Peer roster, quorum status, leadership election state, and cluster health not exposed to operators
missing.evidence_state: Evaluation history, test results, audit logs, and reasoning traces not consolidated for operator review
missing.drill_down_capability: No mechanism that explains WHY work is blocked (e.g., resource constraints, policy gates, failing preconditions)
missing.grant_precondition_verification: No verification that operator actions (via API/CLI) obey the same grants and preconditions as automation. Operator actions (if any exist) bypass the same policy gates enforced on swarm operations

blocking_tasks.title: Implement unified operator control surface API
blocking_tasks.description: Create a cohesive API/CLI endpoint that exposes workload, resource, provider, configuration, federation, and evidence state; add drill-down capabilities; verify operator actions against automation grants

notes: The mastery target requires a unified control surface integrating six distinct dimensions with drill-down and precondition verification. Current implementation provides isolated components (tui_top for monitoring, susi fix for auto-remediation) but no unified surface. The roadmap progress claimed 'PARTIAL' based on provider/GPU/queue rendering, but this is insufficient for mastery since it lacks the other dimensions and does not provide a unified or drill-down interface.
